title: server: the public form submit answer carries the record fields its thank-you panel names (#28005 server half)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-ruled split. #28005 was ruled B by the maintainer at 2026-10-31 15:10Z (ruling record 6545210989): spec first, then server, then ui. This is the server step.
Reach: web-to-case and any public form whose visitor needs a reference (a case number) on the thank-you panel (#27398 row 3).
Duplicate search: open `domain:server` cards with "form" or "thank" in the title. None covers the submit answer.
Blocked-by: #28440 (spec half: the slot, `thankYouRecordFieldNames`, `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema`). Names are pending the maintainer's approval, so read the merged names.

## Wanted

- `POST /api/v1/forms/SLUG/submit` (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`) answers with `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema`. That is `id` always, plus `fields` holding exactly the stored values of the names `thankYouRecordFieldNames(form.submitBehavior)` returns, and only when it returns at least one.
- ⛔ No other field. The route's own comment stays true: the stored row can carry values an elevated hook derived from records the anonymous grant may never read. The spec's lint rule already admits only `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` (today `autonumber`). The server still re-checks each named field's type against that set at answer time, and drops a name that does not pass. That covers an object retyped after publish.
- Name the schema as the route's `responseSchema` in `rest-route-ledger.ts`.

## Tests

- A form whose message names an `autonumber` field answers `{ id, fields: { that_field } }`.
- A form with no token answers `{ id }` only.
- A name whose field was retyped to `text` after publish is dropped.
- Ablation: answering the whole stored row reds the test.

## Then

The ui half (`FormPage.tsx` fills the tokens) is filed beside this card and is blocked by it.
